scope: Unified atomic editing of graph, layout, parameters, source bindings and pairs; complete history and UI integration

build.type: Fresh out-of-tree build followed by final incremental rebuild

counting: QtTest totals include suite initialization and cleanup; counts are not a count of independently validated scientific methods.
new_coverage: Compound graph/source/group failure leaves all state and history unchanged
Prepared candidates are immutable and tied to document identity and revision; undo/redo cannot revive stale edits
Full-state undo/redo, bounded history, no-op suppression and preservation of redo
Source removal retains unresolved pair identity; undo restores the original identity and runnable pair
Unknown/wrong ports, duplicate source/pair identities, self-pairs, invalid topology and batch limits
Joint batch limits do not introduce a cap on ordinary input lists
Run locks reject document mutations and invalidate previously prepared edits
File imports and database source creation commit in one edit; observers see complete state
File options undo/redo; duplicate imports and unchanged options are no-ops
Pair/source/parameter compound edits and undo/redo invalidate and restore preview correctly
Frozen execution manifests and shared immutable numerical buffers remain unchanged

editor_scale_check.numerical_buffers: Shared immutable DataRef; test verifies pointer identity
editor_scale_check.interpretation: Single measurement in this test environment; excludes algorithm execution, file I/O and whole-window repaint. Not a hardware-independent latency guarantee.

limits: No native Windows or macOS execution; final native builds and desktop acceptance remain required.
Node insertion/replacement UI and cross-node joint inputs are not implemented in this batch.
History keeps up to 100 effective edits and may retain immutable source data references; this is not a process memory limit.
Undo does not restore disk file bytes, remove saved database results, or restore viewport/selection state.
Existing numerical suites were rerun; this batch adds no new independent scientific reference implementation.
log_policy: Final successful regression outputs only; workspace and temporary paths sanitized.
